title: JavaScript Drag and Drop File Upload — Companion Resources
title_es: Subida de Archivos Drag and Drop en JavaScript — Recursos complementarios
description: Runnable companion demo for the drag and drop file upload recipe: a complete DragDropUploader class with validation, XHR progress, image previews, folder drop via webkitGetAsEntry, plus a simulated mode that runs without a backend.
description_es: Demo ejecutable de la receta de subida drag and drop: clase DragDropUploader completa con validación, progreso XHR, previews de imagen, drop de carpetas con webkitGetAsEntry y un modo simulado que funciona sin backend.
